text: In a rare flight, a Russian Air Force Tu 154M (RA 85042) VIP transport jet operated by Russia's Defense Ministry has flown from Chkalovsky Air Base near Moscow to Ben Gurion Airport in Tel Aviv.

A ballistic missile launch platform in Sanaa, Yemen, has been destroyed by the Saudi led coalition.

The coalition says the Houthis used the platform in a failed attack on the eastern region.
Footage shows a container ship on fire in the Strait of Hormuz, reported to be a non compliant vessel.

🚨 Iran's government delegation has left Doha just one hour after arriving.

Flight tracking shows the IRAN06 plane heading back toward Iran.

🚨 Trump says a return to war depends on whether Iran signs a deal, warning the U.S. could destroy 38 bridges in Iran in one hour.

He says 3 carriers are ready, targets including power plants and bridges are set, and he will strike Iran again if needed.
🚨 President Trump says a U.S. return to war with Iran is "highly unlikely" as long as negotiations keep moving forward.
An Iranian government plane, flight IRAN06, has landed in Doha after flying in from Tehran.

🚨 One of the oil tankers struck in the Strait of Hormuz in the past 24 hours has been identified as the NAVIG8 MESSI.

It had been sailing with its AIS switched off for 2 days and was on Iran's PGSA list of non compliant vessels.

IDF troops found Hezbollah weapons caches and an operational apartment 200 to 250 meters from UNIFIL positions in Mis al Jabal and Tiri, southern Lebanon.

The IDF says the finds, including humanitarian aid boxes at one site, show "UNIFIL's helplessness."
Update: The death toll from the train collision in El Ayyat, Giza, has risen to 7, Egypt's Health Ministry says, with at least 140 people injured.
Zelensky says Russia has deployed additional forces to Oleshky and nearby villages in the occupied part of Ukraine's Kherson region.

🚨 Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi: American voters have made their choice, now it is the White House's turn.

He says the two day proposal stands: meet its terms, including an end to the war on all fronts, and see results, or choose war and face Iran's forces.
Iraq says foreign aircraft based in Jordan and Turkey have been entering its airspace without permission, listing 9 MQ9 drones, 1 MQ1 drone and 2 Akinci drones.

Attorney General Todd Blanche did not rule out criminal probes of Democratic lawmakers, telling CNN some of their recent statements could amount to a crime.

Asked if they could be imprisoned, as Trump has urged, he said it "depends on what the crime is."
President Trump told CBS News he is planning some changes in his administration, but said he is not ready to reveal any names yet.
A Saudi airstrike destroyed a solar power system at a local farmer's property in Al Munqim, in the Al Durayhimi district of Yemen's Hudaydah province.

Former CIA Director David Petraeus says Russia sustained 1.5 million killed and wounded, more than the United States suffered in all of World War II.

He says Putin will reach a point where he cannot recruit more soldiers, who are poorly trained "human cannon fodder."

Former White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt says Trump was not on the midterm ballot and will never be at the top of the ticket again, adding that Republicans now need someone who is "America First" to lead.
House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries says he is a "hard yes" on the resolution to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.
🚨 Fighter jet activity is being reported over Iraq near the Iranian border.
